name: Justifier-class assault transport
description: The Justifier-class was a class of assault transport manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards. The starship was heavily armed with four laser cannons mounted on the edge of its two wings, a powerful hyperdrive and two engines with a reorienting central thruster that folded flat against the sides of the ship to decrease its size during landings. The cockpit featured several large viewports that provided a wide field of view for pursuing targets. The bounty hunter Cad Bane used a Justifier-class transport named the Justifier during the early Imperial Era.
